name: markdown-dataview
description: Bring Obsidian Dataview to VS Code. Query Markdown notes with DQL (TABLE, LIST, TASK, CALENDAR), inline expressions, and DataviewJS — right in the built-in preview.

dataview.enableJavascript.description: Enable DataviewJS execution in the Markdown preview. WARNING: This runs arbitrary JavaScript from your notes. Only enable if you trust the content of your workspace.

dataview.defaultDateFormat.description: Default date format for Dataview queries.

dataview.defaultDateTimeFormat.description: Default date-time format for Dataview queries.

dataview.taskEmojis.description: Enable parsing of task emoji shorthands (e.g., 🗓️YYYY-MM-DD for due dates).

dataview.excludedFolders.description: Folders to exclude from Dataview indexing.

dataview.warnOnEmptyResult.description: Show a warning in the preview when a query returns no results.

dataview.javascriptTrustedPaths.description: Folder paths trusted for DataviewJS execution. Files in these folders can run JavaScript without warning. Leave empty to trust all files when enableJavascript is true.

scripts.build: npm run check-types && node esbuild.js && node esbuild-preview.js
scripts.watch: node esbuild.js --watch & node esbuild-preview.js --watch & node esbuild-notebook.js --watch
